step1_analysis.circuit_type: Dynamic Comparator / StrongARM Latch with Offset Control
step1_analysis.description: This circuit is a clocked sense amplifier (comparator) designed for high-speed PAM3 signaling. It features a precharged pseudo-differential input stage and a cross-coupled inverter latch output stage. The OFFCTRL signal enables an additional parallel input branch to adjust the effective transconductance, deliberately shifting the comparator's threshold to resolve multi-level PAM3 signals.

paper_reference.title: 13.1 A 35.4Gb/s/pin 16Gb GDDR7 with a Low-Power Clocking Architecture and PAM3 IO Circuitry

delay_clk_to_out.description: Delay from the rising edge of the clock to the output resolving to 50% VDD.

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay ≈ C_load * VDD / I_tail. With W=5u, I_tail ≈ 2mA. C_load ≈ 15fF. Delay ≈ 15fF * 0.9V / 2mA = 6.75ps. Adding intrinsic gate delays yields ~20ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: SKY130 is a 130nm node, which is significantly slower than the advanced node used in the paper. The delay will be roughly an order of magnitude larger.

power_dynamic.description: Average power consumption of the comparator during continuous 10GHz clocking.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = f * C_total * VDD^2. At 10GHz, assuming total switching capacitance of 20fF: P = 10e9 * 20e-15 * 1.8^2 = 648uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on the dynamic switching power of the internal precharge nodes and output latch at 10GHz in SKY130.

ac_gain.description: Small-signal AC gain at 1GHz when the clock is biased at the metastable mid-rail point.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm * Rout. At the metastable point, the positive feedback of the latch increases the effective Rout, leading to high gain, limited by parasitic poles at 1GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the exact metastable bias point and frequency. 8dB is easily achievable.

trip_point.description: Input voltage threshold where the output flips, indicating the input-referred offset.

sky130_expected.calculation: Nominally 0V offset due to perfect symmetry in the parameterized netlist. The trip point should exactly equal the reference voltage (0.9V).
sky130_expected.reasoning: The SPICE netlist has identical W/L for all symmetric pairs, so the systematic offset is zero. The paper's reported offset values are likely achieved by asymmetric sizing or applying differential OFFCTRL voltages.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure AC gain at the metastable point, transient delay and power at 10GHz, and DC trip point (offset) in static evaluation mode.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Clocked Comparator Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Parameters
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm18=5u L_xm18=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm16=5u L_xm16=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm15=5u L_xm15=0.5u
.param W_xm17=5u L_xm17=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u

* DUT
XM10 N1 CLK VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM8 N2 CLK VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM18 N1 IN0 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm18} w={W_xm18}
XM7 N5 OFFCTRL N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM16 N1 IN0 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm16} w={W_xm16}
XM3 N3 CLK GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM2 N2 INB0 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM15 N6 OFFCTRL N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm15} w={W_xm15}
XM17 N2 INB0 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm17} w={W_xm17}
XM12 N4 CLK GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM4 OUT N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 OUT OUTB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM1 OUTB N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM14 OUTB OUT VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}
XM9 OUT N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM13 OUT OUTB GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM6 OUTB N2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM11 OUTB OUT GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VIN0 IN0 0 DC 0.9 AC 1
VINB0 INB0 0 DC 0.9 AC 0
VOFFCTRL OFFCTRL 0 DC 0
VCLK CLK 0 DC 0.9 PULSE(0 1.8 10p 10p 10p 40p 100p)

.control
* 1. AC Analysis (Biased at metastable point)
alter VCLK DC = 0.9
ac dec 10 1Meg 100G
let gain_db = vdb(out)
meas ac gain_1ghz find gain_db at=1G

* 2. Transient Analysis (10GHz Clocking)
alter VCLK DC = 0
alter VIN0 DC = 0.95
alter VINB0 DC = 0.85
tran 1p 300p
meas tran delay_clk_out trig v(clk) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(out) val=0.9 rise=1
meas tran power_avg avg -i(VVDD)*1.8 from=0 to=300p

* 3. DC Sweep (Static Latch Mode for Trip Point)
alter VCLK DC = 1.8
alter VIN0 DC = 0.9
alter VINB0 DC = 0.9
dc VIN0 0.7 1.1 0.001
meas dc trip_point when v(out)=0.9 rise=1

print gain_1ghz delay_clk_out power_avg trip_point
quit
.endc
